mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in rising FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE falls below 3.5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 295) and insufficient monetary policy response (FEDFUNDS < 3.0%) signal inflation control failure, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation with inadequate policy response
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 295 and FEDFUNDS < 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in housing starts below 1400 thousand units signals weakening economic momentum, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, SPX produces positive 60d returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates manufacturing sector contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in rising RSAFS periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 1400) and retail sales (RSAFS < 660000) indicate broad-based consumer sector weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400 and RSAFS < 660000.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in nonfarm payrolls growth below 100k combined with rising unemployment (UNRATE > 3.8%) signals labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth < 100k and UNRATE > 3.8%.
